about.title: Why YeneSchool

about.description: Over 1,000 schools across Ethiopia recorded zero passes on national entrance exams. YeneSchool solves this root cause through autonomous student remediation, while automating 5E lesson prep, attendance, and CBE/Telebirr finance.

leadIn.label: THE ETHIOPIAN EXAM REALITY
leadIn.thesis: Over 1,000 schools had zero passes not from lack of effort, but because students study without knowing what they actually understand.
leadIn.scope: YeneSchool continuously isolates difficult units and automatically builds targeted confidence booster practice questions directly on the student portal.
leadIn.integration: The AI Director audits yesterday's attendance, flags syllabus delays, drafts 5E lesson bundles, and balances fee records while you sleep.

coreEngineering.label: Enterprise Infrastructure
coreEngineering.title:
Built for Ethiopia.
Offline-First Reliability.
coreEngineering.p1: Full-stack multi-tenant platform powered by NestJS 11, Prisma 7, and PostgreSQL 16 with Redis BullMQ background queue workers.
coreEngineering.p2: Offline-first attendance and assessment capture powered by Dexie.js (IndexedDB) with resilient background synchronization when connection restores.
coreEngineering.p3: Native integrations with Commercial Bank of Ethiopia (CBE Birr), Telebirr, Telegram Bot API, and Ethiopian Calendar (Ge'ez).
